thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 14 discussion

opinions.point: Most commenters considered the episode strong, especially praising Yuri’s resourcefulness and determination.
Several commenters enjoyed the series’ historical detail and felt the setting reflected clear research and enthusiasm.
The cast, particularly Yuri, received enthusiastic reactions, with commenters admiring her intelligence and resilience.
Some frustration was directed at unresolved antagonistic characters, while other commenters remained pleased with the episode overall.
One commenter expressed concern that the upcoming episodes may become frustrating.
